name: dsh-opencode-palette
description: DSH Web 多主题引擎：完整支持 opencode 全部 38 个主题（37 内置：33 TUI + 4 桌面 2.0 + system）。数据驱动三层管线：主题 JSON → 颜色解析 → DSH 适配注入。

scripts.deps:sync: npm update dsh-plugin-update dsh-log --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org && node scripts/check-deps.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/check-deps.mjs && node scripts/inline-fonts.mjs && node scripts/build-client.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/engine.test.mjs tests/float-geometry.test.mjs tests/panel-render.test.mjs tests/update-panel.test.mjs tests/log-switch.test.mjs tests/release-scripts.test.mjs tests/sync-verify.test.mjs tests/readme-head-tail.test.mjs tests/readme-body.test.mjs tests/group-boundary.test.mjs
